/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
  A rate integrated since a condition last became true, over the whole trace in one forward pass,
  and its specification over Lean's `Rat`.

  The start at observation `i` is `Temporal.runStartAll`'s: the latest observation `j ≤ i` at which
  the condition rose definitely (false at `j − 1`, true at `j`), with the condition known at every
  observation of `(j, i]`. The value is Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}): zero at the start,
  the rate at an observation covering the interval that ends there. It is unknown, never a value,
  at every observation when the step bound is not positive; where the start is unknown or none is
  observed (`windowTruncated op`, or the condition's reason); where an interval ending at an
  observation of `[j, i]`, the one ending at the start included, is longer than the step bound
  (`samplingGap op`); where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing (`missing`).

  Proved here: the start is exactly the latest definite rise with the condition known since; a
  decided value comes from such a start, a positive bound, intervals within the bound, present rates,
  and equals the discrete sum; each unknown case gives its reason; the value at `i` depends only on
  the inputs at observations `≤ i`; the sum splits at any intermediate observation.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A rational's value in Lean's `Rat`. -/
def Q.val (q : Q) : Rat := mkRat q.num q.den

namespace Accumulate
open Temporal

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The operator
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The running state at an observation: the sum of rate × interval since the trace start (a
    missing rate adds nothing), the latest observation whose rate is missing, and the latest
    observation reached across an interval longer than the step bound. -/
structure Run where
  sum : Q
  lastMissing : Option Nat
  lastWide : Option Nat
  deriving Inhabited

def Run.init : Run := ⟨Q.zero, none, none⟩

/-- The interval ending at observation `i`; zero at the first. -/
def dt (times : Array Q) (i : Nat) : Q := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub times[i]! times[i - 1]!

/-- The state at observation `i` from the state at the observation before. -/
def runStep (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (prev : Run) (i : Nat) : Run :=
  { sum := match rate[i]! with | some ω => Q.add prev.sum (Q.mul ω (dt times i)) | none => prev.sum
    lastMissing := if (rate[i]!).isNone then some i else prev.lastMissing
    lastWide := if i != 0 && Q.gt (dt times i) maxStep then some i else prev.lastWide }

/-- The state at each of the first `n` observations, in one forward pass. -/
def runs (n : Nat) (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) : Array Run :=
  (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Run) i =>
    acc.push (runStep times rate maxStep (if i = 0 then Run.init else acc[i - 1]!) i)) #[]

/-- The value at `i` from the starts and the states. -/
def valueAt (starts : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat))) (rs : Array Run) (op : String)
    (missing : UnknownReason) (i : Nat) : QR :=
  match starts[i]! with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
  | .ok (some j) =>
    if (rs[i]!).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
    else if (rs[i]!).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
    else .ok (Q.sub (rs[i]!).sum (rs[j]!).sum)

/-- Rate × interval accumulated since ψ last became true, per observation. -/
def sinceRiseIntegralAll (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (op : String)
    (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  if Q.lt Q.zero maxStep then
    (Array.range ψ.size).map (valueAt (runStartAll op ψ) (runs ψ.size times rate maxStep) op missing)
  else Array.replicate ψ.size (.error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive"))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The specification
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}) over `Rat`; none where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing;
    zero where `i ≤ j`. -/
def integral (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (j : Nat) : Nat → Option Rat
  | 0 => some 0
  | i + 1 => if i + 1 ≤ j then some 0 else do
      let acc ← integral times rate j i
      let ω ← rate[i + 1]!
      pure (acc + ω.val * ((times[i + 1]!).val - (times[i]!).val))

/-- ψ rises definitely at `j`: false at the observation before, true there. -/
def RisesAt (ψ : Array R) (j : Nat) : Prop := 0 < j ∧ ψ[j - 1]!.v = .f ∧ ψ[j]!.v = .t

/-- `j` is the start at `i`: a definite rise at `j ≤ i`, ψ known and rising nowhere in `(j, i]`. -/
def AnchorAt (ψ : Array R) (j i : Nat) : Prop :=
  j ≤ i ∧ RisesAt ψ j ∧ ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- `Q` in `Rat`
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section QVal

private theorem Q.ext' {a b : Q} (h₁ : a.num = b.num) (h₂ : a.den = b.den) : a = b := by
  cases a; cases b; simp_all

theorem Q.val_mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) : (Q.mk' a b).val = mkRat a b := by
  unfold Q.mk' Q.val
  rw [dif_pos hb]
  simp only
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a.natAbs b := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hb
  have ha : ((Nat.gcd a.natAbs b : Nat) : Int) ∣ a := Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have hbd : Nat.gcd a.natAbs b ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  generalize Nat.gcd a.natAbs b = G at hg ha hbd ⊢
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hbd
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by omega), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg, Rat.mkRat_mul_left (Nat.ne_of_gt hg)]

private theorem den_ne (q : Q) : q.den ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt q.den_pos

theorem Q.val_add (a b : Q) : (Q.add a b).val = a.val + b.val := by
  unfold Q.add
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]

theorem Q.val_mul (a b : Q) : (Q.mul a b).val = a.val * b.val := by
  unfold Q.mul
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_mul_mkRat]

theorem Q.val_sub (a b : Q) : (Q.sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
  unfold Q.sub
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, Rat.neg_mkRat, Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b), Int.neg_mul,
    ← Int.sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem Q.eq_iff_val (a b : Q) : Q.eq a b = true ↔ a.val = b.val := by
  unfold Q.eq Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_eq_iff (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]
  simp

theorem Q.sub_self (a : Q) : Q.sub a a = Q.zero := by
  unfold Q.sub Q.mk'
  have hp : a.den * a.den > 0 := Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos a.den_pos
  rw [dif_pos hp]
  apply Q.ext' <;> simp [Q.zero, Q.ofInt, Int.sub_self, Nat.div_self hp]

theorem Q.le_iff_not_gt (a b : Q) : Q.le a b = true ↔ Q.gt a b = false := by
  unfold Q.le Q.gt Q.lt
  simp [Int.not_lt]

end QVal

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The passes, by observation
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Passes
variable (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (g : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)

/-- One step of `runStartAll`, as its forward pass computes it. -/
def startStep (vals : Array R) (prev : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) (i : Nat) :
    Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
  match vals[i]!.v with
  | .t =>
    if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
    else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
      | .t => prev
      | .f => .ok (some i)
      | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
  | .f => prev
  | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))

/-- The state of `runStartAll` at observation `i`. -/
def startAt (vals : Array R) : Nat → Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)
  | 0 => startStep op vals (.ok none) 0
  | i + 1 => startStep op vals (startAt vals i) (i + 1)

/-- The running state at observation `i`. -/
def runAt : Nat → Run
  | 0 => runStep times rate g Run.init 0
  | i + 1 => runStep times rate g (runAt i) (i + 1)

/-- An array built by pushing, one observation at a time, a value that depends only on the values
    already pushed: its size, and each element as `v` gives it. -/
theorem build_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Array α → Nat → α) (v : Nat → α) (N : Nat)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, i < N → acc.size = i → (∀ m, m < i → acc[m]! = v m) → f acc i = v i) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ N → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[]).size = n ∧
      ∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[])[k]! = v k := by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := ih (by omega)
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun k hk' => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
      exact hk k h
    · subst h
      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]), Array.getElem_push]
      simp only [hs, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
      exact hf _ _ (by omega) hs hk

theorem runs_get (n i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (runs n times rate g)[i]! = runAt times rate g i := by
  unfold runs
  refine (build_get _ (runAt times rate g) n ?_ n (Nat.le_refl _)).2 i hi
  intro acc k _ hs hm
  cases k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]; rw [hm k (by omega)]; rfl

/-- A forward pass whose state is pushed at each observation, one value at a time: its size and each
    element as `v` gives it. -/
theorem pairs_get {β : Type} [Inhabited β] (s : β → Nat → β) (init : β) (v : Nat → β)
    (h0 : s init 0 = v 0) (hs : ∀ m, s (v m) (m + 1) = v (m + 1)) : ∀ n,
    ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1.size = n ∧
    (∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1[k]! = v k) ∧
    (∀ m, n = m + 1 → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 = v m) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hsz, hk, h2⟩ := ih
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    have hst : s ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 n = v n := by
      cases n with
      | zero => simpa using h0
      | succ m => rw [h2 m rfl]; exact hs m
    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], fun k hk' => ?_, fun m hm => by cases hm; exact hst⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
      exact hk k h
    · subst h
      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]), Array.getElem_push]
      simp only [hsz, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
      exact hst

theorem runStartAll_get (vals : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < vals.size) :
    (runStartAll op vals)[i]! = startAt op vals i := by
  unfold runStartAll
  dsimp only
  rw [Array.mkEmpty_eq]
  exact (pairs_get (startStep op vals) (.ok none) (startAt op vals) rfl (fun _ => rfl) vals.size).2.1 i hi

end Passes

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The start
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Start
variable {op : String} {ψ : Array R}

theorem AnchorAt.mono {j i i' : Nat} (h : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i') : AnchorAt ψ j i :=
  ⟨hji, h.2.1, fun k h1 h2 => h.2.2 k h1 (Nat.le_trans h2 hii)⟩

/-- T2: the start is `j` exactly where `j` is the latest definite rise with ψ known since. -/
theorem startAt_some_iff (i j : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok (some j) ↔ AnchorAt ψ j i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
          refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
          · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
          · subst hk; refine ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, hf, _⟩ => ?_⟩
            simp [hp] at hf
        · cases h
          exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩, fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega)⟩
        · cases h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
        refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
        · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
        · subst hk; exact ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, _, ht⟩ => by simp [hv] at ht⟩
      · cases h
  · intro ⟨hji, hr, hk⟩
    induction i with
    | zero => exact absurd hr.1 (by omega)
    | succ m ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
      · have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hk k h1 (by omega))
        obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := hk (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
        simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
        | u => exact absurd hv hu
        | f => exact ih'
        | t =>
          have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
            cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
            | t => rfl
            | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
            | u =>
              rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt) with h | h
              · exact absurd hp (hk m h (by omega)).1
              · subst h; have := hr.2.2; rw [hp] at this; cases this
          simp only [hp]; exact ih'
      · subst heq
        obtain ⟨_, hf, ht⟩ := hr
        simp only [startAt, startStep, ht, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hf
        simp [hf]

/-- T3: no start observed exactly where ψ has been false at every observation so far. -/
theorem startAt_none_iff (i : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok none ↔ ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk; have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      subst hk0
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h ⊢
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
        · have := ih h i (Nat.le_refl _); rw [hp] at this; cases this
        · cases h
        · cases h
      · intro k hk
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk) with hk' | hk'
        · exact ih h k (by omega)
        · subst hk'; exact hv
      · cases h
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep, h (i + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)]
      exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))

/-- A run of true values reaching the first observation, with ψ known and rising nowhere since,
    leaves the start truncated: the onset may lie before the recording. -/
theorem startAt_truncated (i : Nat) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
    startAt op ψ i = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h0]
  | succ m ih =>
    have ih' := ih (fun k h1 h2 => h k h1 (by omega))
    obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := h (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
    | u => exact absurd hv hu
    | f => exact ih'
    | t =>
      have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
        cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
        | t => rfl
        | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
        | u =>
          cases m with
          | zero => rw [h0] at hp; cases hp
          | succ m' => exact absurd hp (h (m' + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).1
      simp only [hp]; exact ih'

theorem startAt_congr {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
    startAt op ψ i = startAt op ψ' i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp only [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      h (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), h m (by omega), ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))]

end Start

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The running state
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section RunState
variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q}

theorem lastWide_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true ↔
      ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ Q.gt (dt times k) g = true := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [runAt, runStep, Run.init]; intro k _ hk h; omega
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    by_cases hw : Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g = true
    · have hc : (i + 1 != 0 && Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g) = true := by simp [hw]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      simp only [Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, by omega, hw⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _, _⟩; omega
    · simp only [hw, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
        · subst hk; exact absurd h4 hw

theorem lastMissing_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true ↔ ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    cases hr : rate[0]! <;> simp [Run.init] <;> intro k h1 h2 <;> omega
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    cases hr : rate[i + 1]! with
    | none =>
      simp only [Option.isNone_none, if_true, Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, hr⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _⟩; omega
    | some ω =>
      simp only [Option.isNone_some, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
        · subst hk; rw [hr] at h3; cases h3

theorem integral_le (j i : Nat) (h : i ≤ j) : integral times rate j i = some 0 := by
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i => simp [integral, h]

/-- With every rate of `(j, i]` present, the specification is the difference of the running sums. -/
theorem integral_eq_sum (j i : Nat) (hji : j ≤ i) (hr : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    integral times rate j i = some ((runAt times rate g i).sum.val - (runAt times rate g j).sum.val) := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this; simp only [integral]; congr 1; grind
  | succ i ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
      have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hr k h1 (by omega))
      obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hr (i + 1) hlt (Nat.le_refl _))
      simp only [integral, hj, if_false, ih', hω, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]
      simp only [runAt, runStep, hω, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [Q.val_add, Q.val_mul, Q.val_sub]
      congr 1
      grind
    · subst heq; rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]; congr 1; grind

theorem runAt_congr {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} (i : Nat)
    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!) :
    runAt times rate g i = runAt times' rate' g i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, hr 0 (Nat.le_refl _), if_true]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      hr (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht m (by omega),
      ih (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]

end RunState

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The theorems of the operator. `F` below is `sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ`.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Operator
variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q} {op : String} {missing : UnknownReason} {ψ : Array R}

/-- T1: one value per observation. -/
theorem size_sinceRiseIntegralAll : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll; split <;> simp

theorem get_pos (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! =
      match startAt op ψ i with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
      | .ok (some j) =>
        if (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
        else if (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
        else .ok (Q.sub (runAt times rate g i).sum (runAt times rate g j).sum) := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
  rw [if_pos hg, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range, valueAt]
  rw [runStartAll_get op ψ i hi, runs_get times rate g _ i hi]
  cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
  | error e => rfl
  | ok o =>
    cases o with
    | none => rfl
    | some j =>
      simp only [runs_get times rate g _ j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1 hi)]

/-- Under a step bound that is not positive, every observation is unknown, malformed. -/
theorem not_positive (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = false) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive") := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
  rw [if_neg (by simp [hg]), getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

private theorem gap_of_le {j i : Nat}
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = false := by
  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := (lastWide_any_iff i j).mp h
    have := (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mp (hgap k h1 h2)
    simp only [dt, h3, if_false] at h4
    rw [this] at h4; cases h4

private theorem rate_of_some {j i : Nat} (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = false := by
  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mp h
    have := hrate k h1 h2; rw [h3] at this; cases this

/-- T4: at an observed start with a positive bound, intervals within the bound from the one ending
    at the start, and every rate since present, the value is decided and is the discrete sum. -/
theorem at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
    (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    ∃ q, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q ∧ integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, rate_of_some hrate, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, Q.val_sub]⟩

/-- The value at a start whose bracket interval is within the bound is zero. -/
theorem zero_at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (j : Nat) (hj : j < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j j)
    (hgap : Q.le (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[j]! = .ok Q.zero := by
  rw [get_pos hg j hj, (startAt_some_iff j j).mpr ha]
  have hw := gap_of_le (times := times) (rate := rate) (j := j) (i := j)
    (fun k h1 h2 => by have : k = j := by omega
                       subst this; exact hgap)
  have hm := rate_of_some (times := times) (rate := rate) (g := g) (j := j) (i := j)
    (fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega))
  simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Q.sub_self]

/-- T5: a decided value comes from a positive bound and an observed start, intervals within the
    bound from the one ending at the start, every rate since present, and is the discrete sum. -/
theorem decided_anchored (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (q : Q)
    (h : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q) :
    Q.lt Q.zero g = true ∧ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i ∧
      (∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) ∧
      (∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) ∧
      integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi] at h; cases h
  | true =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [get_pos hg i hi] at h
    cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
    | error e => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
    | ok o =>
      cases o with
      | none => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
      | some j =>
        simp only [hs] at h
        have ha := (startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs
        cases hw : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
        | true => simp [hw] at h
        | false =>
          cases hm : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
          | true => simp [hw, hm] at h
          | false =>
            simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Except.ok.injEq] at h
            have hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true := by
              intro k h1 h2
              have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
              cases hgt : Q.gt (dt times k) g with
              | false => simp only [dt, hk0, if_false] at hgt; exact (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mpr hgt
              | true =>
                have := (lastWide_any_iff (rate := rate) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, hgt⟩
                rw [hw] at this; cases this
            have hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome := by
              intro k h1 h2
              cases hr : rate[k]! with
              | some _ => rfl
              | none =>
                have := (lastMissing_any_iff (times := times) (g := g) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hr⟩
                rw [hm] at this; cases this
            refine ⟨j, ha, hgap, hrate, ?_⟩
            rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, ← h, Q.val_sub]

/-- T6: ψ false at every observation so far: unknown, truncated. -/
theorem none_observed (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_none_iff i).mpr h]

/-- T6: ψ true at the first observation and known with no definite rise since: unknown, truncated. -/
theorem onset_before_recording (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, startAt_truncated i h0 h]

/-- T6: no observed start: unknown. -/
theorem no_anchor_unknown (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ¬ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i) :
    ∃ e, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error e := by
  cases hd : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! with
  | error e => exact ⟨e, rfl⟩
  | ok q => obtain ⟨_, j, ha, _⟩ := decided_anchored i hi q hd; exact absurd ⟨j, ha⟩ h

/-- T7: an interval longer than the bound ending at an observation of `[j, i]`: a sampling gap. -/
theorem wide_interval (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hk : ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ Q.gt (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hk
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true :=
    (lastWide_any_iff i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, by simpa [dt, hk0] using h3⟩
  simp only [this, if_true]

/-- T7: the bracket of the start (the interval ending at it) longer than the bound: a sampling gap. -/
theorem bracket_wide (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hb : Q.gt (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) :=
  wide_interval hg i j hi ha ⟨j, Nat.le_refl _, ha.1, hb⟩

/-- T7: a missing rate since the start, with every interval within the bound: `missing`. -/
theorem missing_rate (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
    (hk : ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error missing := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mpr hk
  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, this, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]

/-- T8: the value at `i` depends only on the times, rates and ψ at observations `≤ i`. -/
theorem causal {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < ψ.size) (hi' : i < ψ'.size)
    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!)
    (hψ : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = (sinceRiseIntegralAll times' rate' g op missing ψ')[i]! := by
  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi, not_positive hg i hi']
  | true =>
    rw [get_pos hg i hi, get_pos hg i hi', startAt_congr i hψ, runAt_congr i ht hr]
    cases hs : startAt op ψ' i with
    | error e => rfl
    | ok o =>
      cases o with
      | none => rfl
      | some j =>
        have hj : j ≤ i := ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1
        simp only [runAt_congr j (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]

/-- T9: the sum splits at any intermediate observation. -/
theorem integral_split (j m i : Nat) (hjm : j ≤ m) (hmi : m ≤ i) :
    integral times rate j i = (do let a ← integral times rate j m; let b ← integral times rate m i; pure (a + b)) := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : m = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : j = 0 := by omega
    subst h1; subst h2; simp [integral, Rat.add_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmi) with hlt | heq
    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
      have hm : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ m) := by omega
      simp only [integral, hj, hm, if_false, ih (by omega)]
      cases integral times rate j m <;> cases integral times rate m i <;> cases rate[i + 1]! <;>
        simp [Rat.add_assoc]
    · subst heq
      rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]
      cases integral times rate j (i + 1) <;> simp [Rat.add_zero]

/-- T9: between two decided observations of one start, the sum is the difference of the values. -/
theorem accumulates (i i' j : Nat) (hi' : i' < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i')
    (a b : Q) (h1 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok a)
    (h2 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i']! = .ok b) :
    integral times rate i i' = some (b.val - a.val) := by
  obtain ⟨_, j₁, ha₁, _, _, hI₁⟩ := decided_anchored i (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hii hi') a h1
  obtain ⟨_, j₂, ha₂, _, _, hI₂⟩ := decided_anchored i' hi' b h2
  have e₁ : j₁ = j := by
    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i j₁).mpr ha₁).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i j).mpr (ha.mono hji hii))
    cases this; rfl
  have e₂ : j₂ = j := by
    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i' j₂).mpr ha₂).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i' j).mpr ha)
    cases this; rfl
  rw [e₁] at hI₁; rw [e₂] at hI₂
  have hs := integral_split (times := times) (rate := rate) j i i' hji hii
  rw [hI₂, hI₁] at hs
  cases hx : integral times rate i i' with
  | none => rw [hx] at hs; simp at hs
  | some x =>
    rw [hx] at hs
    simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    congr 1; grind

end Operator

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
  What a specification is: binders with class formulas, an applicability and an obligation, and
  the declarations a reviewer needs (parameters, assumptions, declared intentions,
  operationalizations, residues, narrowings, the rules it composes, the surrogate flag).

  A residue is a span of the text the rule does not capture at all; the plan declares it and the
  rule repeats it verbatim. A narrowing is a reading the coder chose on a span the plan does
  carry, stated here so the review judges the rule as it is: the span it names and why. The
  coder may add narrowings and never residues.

  Applicability and obligation are two formulas because a rule whose situation never arises is
  not compliant, it is not engaged: `notApplicable` is a verdict of its own, the witness check can
  demand a scenario for it, and a monitor reads the applicability as the trigger and the
  obligation as what to verify once triggered.

  A surrogate rule (the whole duty is an operationalized standard) is monitored like any other,
  but its verdicts are evidence about the standard, never the law's own verdict; the flag is what
  the monitor and the export propagate so the two are never summed.

  This file holds the declarations only and imports no evaluator: a rule file that imports it
  can state a rule but cannot read a scene, evaluate a formula or build evidence. Evaluation and
  the static check are in RuleEval.lean, which nothing under Rules/ may import.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A binder: a variable and the class formula (over `ru_*` atoms and class-level derived
    concepts) a track must satisfy to be bound to it. The subject comes first. -/
structure Binder where
  name : String
  cls : Formula
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A reading chosen on a span the record carries, declared where it is made: the span (a
    segmentation id for a rule, a run of the contract's words for a concept) and what the formulas
    state more narrowly than the words. `kind` is `reading` where the words leave the choice open,
    `observable_reading` where a word with no observable counterpart is read through the conduct
    or the feature it refers to, `no_atom` or `no_operator` where the vocabulary or the language
    cannot state the words — a declaration the gate returns for a gap, never a reading the rule
    stands on. -/
structure Narrowing where
  span : String
  why : String
  kind : String := "reading"
  deriving Repr, Inhabited, DecidableEq

structure Rule where
  id : String                                   -- the node id, derived from the law id
  laws : List String                            -- the corpus ids this rule formalizes
  binders : List Binder
  applicability : Formula
  obligation : Formula
  assumptions : List AsmId := []
  intentions : List IntId := []                 -- the declared intentions its formulas read
  operationalizations : List Operationalization := []
  residues : List String := []                  -- what the text says and the rule does not capture
  narrowings : List Narrowing := []             -- readings the coder chose on carried spans
  surrogate : Bool := false
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

inductive Verdict
  | violated
  | compliant
  | notApplicable
  | unknown (why : List UnknownReason)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace Verdict
def tag : Verdict → String
  | .violated => "violated"
  | .compliant => "compliant"
  | .notApplicable => "not_applicable"
  | .unknown _ => "unknown"
def reasons : Verdict → List UnknownReason
  | .unknown w => w
  | _ => []
instance : ToString Verdict := ⟨tag⟩
end Verdict

/-- Kleene combination of the two formulas: not engaged ↦ notApplicable, engaged and the
    obligation decided ↦ compliant/violated, anything undecided ↦ unknown with its reasons. -/
def verdictAt (app obl : R) : Verdict :=
  match app.v with
  | .f => .notApplicable
  | .u => .unknown app.why
  | .t =>
    match obl.v with
    | .t => .compliant
    | .f => .violated
    | .u => .unknown obl.why

theorem verdictAt_notApplicable (app obl : R) (h : app.v = .f) : verdictAt app obl = .notApplicable := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [h]
theorem verdictAt_violated (app obl : R) (ha : app.v = .t) (ho : obl.v = .f) : verdictAt app obl = .violated := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [ha, ho]
theorem verdictAt_compliant (app obl : R) (ha : app.v = .t) (ho : obl.v = .t) : verdictAt app obl = .compliant := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [ha, ho]

namespace Rule
/-- The formulas a rule consists of, class formulas first. -/
def formulas (r : Rule) : List Formula := r.binders.map (·.cls) ++ [r.applicability, r.obligation]
/-- Atom, primitive and concept names the rule reads. -/
def atoms (r : Rule) : List String := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.atoms).eraseDups
/-- Reading parameters the rule names. -/
def params (r : Rule) : List ParamName := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.params).eraseDups
/-- Rules the rule composes. -/
def composes (r : Rule) : List String := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.composed).eraseDups
/-- Assumptions the formulas read. -/
def usedAssumptions (r : Rule) : List AsmId := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.assumptions).eraseDups
/-- Declared intentions the formulas read. -/
def usedIntentions (r : Rule) : List IntId := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.intentions).eraseDups
def binderNames (r : Rule) : List String := r.binders.map (·.name)
def subject (r : Rule) : Option String := r.binders.head?.map (·.name)

/-- The rule and, transitively, the rules it composes (each once). -/
def closure (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : List Rule :=
  let rec go (fuel : Nat) (seen : List String) (todo : List Rule) : List Rule :=
    match fuel, todo with
    | 0, _ | _, [] => []
    | fuel + 1, x :: rest =>
      let next := x.composes.filterMap fun id =>
        if seen.contains id then none else rules.find? (·.id == id)
      x :: go fuel (seen ++ next.map (·.id)) (rest ++ next)
  go (rules.length + 1) [r.id] [r]

/-- Whether the rule reads a declared intention, in its own formulas or through a rule it
    composes at any depth. -/
def readsIntention (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  (closure rules r).any fun x => !x.usedIntentions.isEmpty
end Rule

end TrafficSpec

/-
  NRS_484B_227_1_o2 — NRS-484B-227-1

  THE READING (the blueprint's; the coding session records here, per span, how each element,
  operationalization and composition below is written, and every choice the text did not dictate).

  Spans:
    s1 (subject): Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway
    s2 (sibling): must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway
    s3 (obligation): and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn,
    s4 (exception): except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

  Elements (span → atoms, derived):
    s1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle', 'st.highway', 'st.roadway', 'st.median_or_divider', 'st.on_way', 'rel.occupies'], derived ['drv.motion.standstill']
    s3: atoms ['st.median_or_divider', 'rel.occupies', 'st.highway', 'st.on_way'], derived ['drv.motion.left_turn', 'drv.motion.u_turn']
    s4: atoms ['st.median_or_divider', 'st.intersection', 'rel.occupies', 'st.on_way'], derived []

  How each span is written.

  s1 — the subject and the trigger (`clsV`, `applicability`).
    "vehicle" is the binder's class: `ru_aggregate` of `v` with the admitted aggregate id
    DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, the id and never the classes it covers. "driven" is the controlled
    motion of the record's observable reading: the negation of `drv.motion.standstill` with
    p.standstill_speed_tolerance. "upon a divided highway" is `onDividedWay`: `rel.occupies` of a
    region `w` that `st.highway` decides is a way, on which (`st.on_way`) a `st.median_or_divider`
    region lies and two `st.roadway` regions lie that `same` tells apart — DEF-NRS-484A-070's
    "divided into two or more roadways by means of a physical barrier or dividing section", read
    through the roadway contract's "separate roadways of a divided highway are separate".

  s3 — the duty (`obligation`). The way is selected again, whole, inside the obligation (the
    applicability's `w` is not in scope here), and the duty is read at every way so selected:
      (a) "driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section" is
          `clearOfDividerOn`: no `st.median_or_divider` region lying (`st.on_way`) on that way is
          overlapped by the vehicle's footprint (`rel.occupies`) — the record's reading of the
          three prepositions as one overlap;
      (b) "make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn" is `turnRecognized`: the observation at
          which `drv.motion.left_turn` (p.turn_onset_yaw_rate, p.left_turn_angle,
          p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph) or `drv.motion.u_turn` (the same onset rate and
          step bound with p.u_turn_reversal_angle) first becomes true — `.rises` of the concept,
          the recognition the occasion declares. "upon a highway" of DEF-NRS-484B-077 is the way
          already selected (`st.highway`, `st.on_way`, `rel.occupies`), on which the vehicle is.

  s4 — the exception (`excused`, in the applicability). "an opening in the barrier or dividing
    section or space" and "a crossover" are one fact: a `st.median_or_divider` region on that way
    whose opening attribute holds and whose region the vehicle's footprint overlaps
    (`atOpeningOn`); "or intersection" is `st.intersection` on that way, overlapped likewise
    (`atJunctionOn`). "established by a public authority" is the presence of the feature (the
    record's observable reading). The occasion's boundary is an event, so the span is read
    `throughout` the act: at an observation at which a turn is recognized, the exception excuses it
    only where it has held at every observation from the declared onset — the observation at which
    the rate of change of heading rose above the onset yaw rate (`onsetV`, from `kin.yaw_rate`) —
    to that recognition (`excusedThroughoutAct`, `.since` with the onset as its anchor, so the
    stretch walked is the act's own and no window is invented). At an observation at which no turn
    is recognized the act is the driving over the dividing space, and the exception excuses it
    where the vehicle overlaps the opening, crossover or intersection at that observation.

  No magnitude below is this file's own: parameters name the reading, literals are the text's.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_227_1_o2

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vV : Arg := .var "v"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph : Term := .param "p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph"
def pLeftTurnAngle : Term := .param "p.left_turn_angle"
def pStandstillSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.standstill_speed_tolerance"
def pTurnOnsetYawRate : Term := .param "p.turn_onset_yaw_rate"
def pUTurnReversalAngle : Term := .param "p.u_turn_reversal_angle"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- Class of `v`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsV : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vV, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- "driven": the vehicle's motion is not a complete cessation from movement. -/
def movingV : Formula := .not (.derived "drv_motion_standstill" [vV] [pStandstillSpeedTolerance])

/-- The vehicle's footprint overlaps the region `r`. -/
def occupiesV (r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [vV, .var r] []

/-- The region `r` lies on the way `w`. -/
def onWayOf (r w : String) : Formula := .atom "st_on_way" [.var r, .var w] []

/-- `r` is a dividing space, barrier or section lying on the way `w`. -/
def dividerOn (r w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_median_or_divider" [.var r] []) (onWayOf r w)

/-- A divided highway: a way divided into two or more roadways by a physical barrier or dividing
    section lying on it. -/
def dividedWay (w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_highway" [.var w] [])
    (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "dw" (dividerOn "dw" w))
      (.existsRegion (.lit "roadway") "rwa"
        (.and (.atom "st_roadway" [.var "rwa"] [])
          (.and (onWayOf "rwa" w)
            (.existsRegion (.lit "roadway") "rwb"
              (.and (.atom "st_roadway" [.var "rwb"] [])
                (.and (onWayOf "rwb" w)
                  (.not (.same (.var "rwa") (.var "rwb"))))))))))

/-- s1's way, selected whole: the divided highway the vehicle is driven upon. -/
def onDividedWay (w : String) : Formula := .and (occupiesV w) (dividedWay w)

/-- s4: the vehicle overlaps an opening in the barrier or dividing section — a crossover — on `w`. -/
def atOpeningOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "op"
    (.and (.atom "st_median_or_divider" [.var "op"] [])
      (.and (.atom "st_median_or_divider_opening" [.var "op"] [])
        (.and (onWayOf "op" w) (occupiesV "op"))))

/-- s4: the vehicle overlaps an intersection established on `w`. -/
def atJunctionOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "jx"
    (.and (.atom "st_intersection" [.var "jx"] [])
      (.and (onWayOf "jx" w) (occupiesV "jx")))

/-- s4 at this observation. -/
def exceptionHere (w : String) : Formula := .or (atOpeningOn w) (atJunctionOn w)

/-- The occasion's reading of turning: the rate of change of heading stands above the onset rate. -/
def turningV : Formula := .cmp (.abs (.measure "kin_yaw_rate" [vV])) .gt pTurnOnsetYawRate

/-- The occasion's onset: the observation at which that rate first rose above the onset rate. -/
def onsetV : Formula := .rises turningV

def leftTurnV : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_left_turn" [vV]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnOnsetYawRate, pLeftTurnAngle]

def uTurnV : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_u_turn" [vV]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnOnsetYawRate, pUTurnReversalAngle]

/-- The occasion's recognition: the observation at which a left turn or a reversal is first
    recognized. -/
def turnRecognized : Formula := .or (.rises leftTurnV) (.rises uTurnV)

/-- s4 throughout the act: the exception has held at every observation from the declared onset of
    this manoeuvre to this one. -/
def excusedThroughoutAct (w : String) : Formula :=
  .since (exceptionHere w) (.and onsetV (exceptionHere w))

/-- s4, excusing the act judged at this observation: the overlap here, and — where a turn is
    recognized here — the overlap throughout the act. -/
def excused (w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (exceptionHere w) (.implies turnRecognized (excusedThroughoutAct w))

/-- No dividing space, barrier or section of `w` is overlapped by the vehicle's footprint. -/
def clearOfDividerOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .not (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "dv"
    (.and (dividerOn "dv" w) (occupiesV "dv")))

/-- Applicability: s1, with s4 (exception): except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and movingV
    (.existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
      (.and (onDividedWay "w") (.not (excused "w"))))

/-- Obligation: s3 (obligation): and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
    (.implies (onDividedWay "w")
      (.and (clearOfDividerOn "w") (.not turnRecognized)))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_227_1_o2"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-227-1"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "v", cls := clsV } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := []
    operationalizations := []
    residues := []  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_227_1_o2

  NRS_484B_227_1_o2 — NRS-484B-227-1

  THE READING (the blueprint's; the coding session records here, per span, how each element,
  operationalization and composition below is written, and every choice the text did not dictate).

  Spans:
    s1 (subject): Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway
    s2 (sibling): must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway
    s3 (obligation): and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn,
    s4 (exception): except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

  Elements (span → atoms, derived):
    s1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle', 'st.highway', 'st.roadway', 'st.median_or_divider', 'st.on_way', 'rel.occupies'], derived ['drv.motion.standstill']
    s3: atoms ['st.median_or_divider', 'rel.occupies', 'st.highway', 'st.on_way'], derived ['drv.motion.left_turn', 'drv.motion.u_turn']
    s4: atoms ['st.median_or_divider', 'st.intersection', 'rel.occupies', 'st.on_way'], derived []

  How each span is written.

  s1 — the subject and the trigger (`clsV`, `applicability`).
    "vehicle" is the binder's class: `ru_aggregate` of `v` with the admitted aggregate id
    DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, the id and never the classes it covers. "driven" is the controlled
    motion of the record's observable reading: the negation of `drv.motion.standstill` with
    p.standstill_speed_tolerance. "upon a divided highway" is `onDividedWay`: `rel.occupies` of a
    region `w` that `st.highway` decides is a way, on which (`st.on_way`) a `st.median_or_divider`
    region lies and two `st.roadway` regions lie that `same` tells apart — DEF-NRS-484A-070's
    "divided into two or more roadways by means of a physical barrier or dividing section", read
    through the roadway contract's "separate roadways of a divided highway are separate".

  s3 — the duty (`obligation`). The way is selected again, whole, inside the obligation (the
    applicability's `w` is not in scope here), and the duty is read at every way so selected:
      (a) "driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section" is
          `clearOfDividerOn`: no `st.median_or_divider` region lying (`st.on_way`) on that way is
          overlapped by the vehicle's footprint (`rel.occupies`) — the record's reading of the
          three prepositions as one overlap;
      (b) "make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn" is `turnRecognized`: the observation at
          which `drv.motion.left_turn` (p.turn_onset_yaw_rate, p.left_turn_angle,
          p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph) or `drv.motion.u_turn` (the same onset rate and
          step bound with p.u_turn_reversal_angle) first becomes true — `.rises` of the concept,
          the recognition the occasion declares. "upon a highway" of DEF-NRS-484B-077 is the way
          already selected (`st.highway`, `st.on_way`, `rel.occupies`), on which the vehicle is.

  s4 — the exception (`excused`, in the applicability). "an opening in the barrier or dividing
    section or space" and "a crossover" are one fact: a `st.median_or_divider` region on that way
    whose opening attribute holds and whose region the vehicle's footprint overlaps
    (`atOpeningOn`); "or intersection" is `st.intersection` on that way, overlapped likewise
    (`atJunctionOn`). "established by a public authority" is the presence of the feature (the
    record's observable reading). The occasion's boundary is an event, so the span is read
    `throughout` the act: at an observation at which a turn is recognized, the exception excuses it
    only where it has held at every observation from the declared onset — the observation at which
    the rate of change of heading rose above the onset yaw rate (`onsetV`, from `kin.yaw_rate`) —
    to that recognition (`excusedThroughoutAct`, `.since` with the onset as its anchor, so the
    stretch walked is the act's own and no window is invented). At an observation at which no turn
    is recognized the act is the driving over the dividing space, and the exception excuses it
    where the vehicle overlaps the opening, crossover or intersection at that observation.

  No magnitude below is this file's own: parameters name the reading, literals are the text's.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_227_1_o2

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vV : Arg := .var "v"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph : Term := .param "p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph"
def pLeftTurnAngle : Term := .param "p.left_turn_angle"
def pStandstillSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.standstill_speed_tolerance"
def pTurnOnsetYawRate : Term := .param "p.turn_onset_yaw_rate"
def pUTurnReversalAngle : Term := .param "p.u_turn_reversal_angle"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- Class of `v`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsV : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vV, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- "driven": the vehicle's motion is not a complete cessation from movement. -/
def movingV : Formula := .not (.derived "drv_motion_standstill" [vV] [pStandstillSpeedTolerance])

/-- The vehicle's footprint overlaps the region `r`. -/
def occupiesV (r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [vV, .var r] []

/-- The region `r` lies on the way `w`. -/
def onWayOf (r w : String) : Formula := .atom "st_on_way" [.var r, .var w] []

/-- `r` is a dividing space, barrier or section lying on the way `w`. -/
def dividerOn (r w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_median_or_divider" [.var r] []) (onWayOf r w)

/-- A divided highway: a way divided into two or more roadways by a physical barrier or dividing
    section lying on it. -/
def dividedWay (w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_highway" [.var w] [])
    (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "dw" (dividerOn "dw" w))
      (.existsRegion (.lit "roadway") "rwa"
        (.and (.atom "st_roadway" [.var "rwa"] [])
          (.and (onWayOf "rwa" w)
            (.existsRegion (.lit "roadway") "rwb"
              (.and (.atom "st_roadway" [.var "rwb"] [])
                (.and (onWayOf "rwb" w)
                  (.not (.same (.var "rwa") (.var "rwb"))))))))))

/-- s1's way, selected whole: the divided highway the vehicle is driven upon. -/
def onDividedWay (w : String) : Formula := .and (occupiesV w) (dividedWay w)

/-- s4: the vehicle overlaps an opening in the barrier or dividing section — a crossover — on `w`. -/
def atOpeningOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "op"
    (.and (.atom "st_median_or_divider" [.var "op"] [])
      (.and (.atom "st_median_or_divider_opening" [.var "op"] [])
        (.and (onWayOf "op" w) (occupiesV "op"))))

/-- s4: the vehicle overlaps an intersection established on `w`. -/
def atJunctionOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "jx"
    (.and (.atom "st_intersection" [.var "jx"] [])
      (.and (onWayOf "jx" w) (occupiesV "jx")))

/-- s4 at this observation. -/
def exceptionHere (w : String) : Formula := .or (atOpeningOn w) (atJunctionOn w)

/-- The occasion's reading of turning: the rate of change of heading stands above the onset rate. -/
def turningV : Formula := .cmp (.abs (.measure "kin_yaw_rate" [vV])) .gt pTurnOnsetYawRate

/-- The occasion's onset: the observation at which that rate first rose above the onset rate. -/
def onsetV : Formula := .rises turningV

def leftTurnV : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_left_turn" [vV]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnOnsetYawRate, pLeftTurnAngle]

def uTurnV : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_u_turn" [vV]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnOnsetYawRate, pUTurnReversalAngle]

/-- The occasion's recognition: the observation at which a left turn or a reversal is first
    recognized. -/
def turnRecognized : Formula := .or (.rises leftTurnV) (.rises uTurnV)

/-- s4 throughout the act: the exception has held at every observation from the declared onset of
    this manoeuvre to this one. -/
def excusedThroughoutAct (w : String) : Formula :=
  .since (exceptionHere w) (.and onsetV (exceptionHere w))

/-- s4, excusing the act judged at this observation: the overlap here, and — where a turn is
    recognized here — the overlap throughout the act. -/
def excused (w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (exceptionHere w) (.implies turnRecognized (excusedThroughoutAct w))

/-- No dividing space, barrier or section of `w` is overlapped by the vehicle's footprint. -/
def clearOfDividerOn (w : String) : Formula :=
  .not (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "dv"
    (.and (dividerOn "dv" w) (occupiesV "dv")))

/-- Applicability: s1, with s4 (exception): except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and movingV
    (.existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
      (.and (onDividedWay "w") (.not (excused "w"))))

/-- Obligation: s3 (obligation): and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
    (.implies (onDividedWay "w")
      (.and (clearOfDividerOn "w") (.not turnRecognized)))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_227_1_o2"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-227-1"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "v", cls := clsV } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := []
    operationalizations := []
    residues := []  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_227_1_o2

            (if k < 5 then Q.zero else Units.degrees 30) ]
      junctionHighway
      []
      (some (if k < 32 then [(1, 1), (1, 2)] else [(1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 6)]))

7	  Which assignments of tracks to binders exist over a trace, how a broken track is followed, and
8	  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.
9	
10	  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
11	  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
12	  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
13	  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
14	  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.
15	
16	  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
17	  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
18	  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.
19	
20	  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.

22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	namespace Grounding
27	open Semantics
28	
29	/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
30	    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
31	structure Grounding where
32	  assign : List (String × TrackId)
33	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
34	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
35	
36	def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
37	  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
38	def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
39	  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩
40	
41	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
43	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
45	def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
46	  let c := canon cm
47	  { s with
48	    subject := s.subject.map c
49	    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
50	    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
51	    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
52	    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
53	    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }
54	
55	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
56	-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
57	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	structure Setup where
59	  rules : List Rule
60	  d : Primitives.Ctx
61	  gap : Q
62	  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
63	
64	def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
65	  let arr := τ.toArray
66	  let cm := canonMap arr gap
67	  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }
68	
69	/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
70	    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
71	def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
72	  match Admission.defects τ gap with
73	  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
74	  | ds => .error ds
75	
76	def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
77	def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
78	def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
79	def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
80	/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
81	def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
82	  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
83	  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
84	  | _, _ => none
85	
86	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	-- Enumeration
88	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
89	/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
90	def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
91	  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
92	    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t
93	
94	def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
95	  match S.span a, S.span b with
96	  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
97	  | _, _ => false
98	
99	/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
100	    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
101	def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
102	  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
103	  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
104	    match bs with
105	    | [] => [[]]
106	    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
107	      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
108	        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
109	  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }
110	
111	/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
112	    bound when candidates overlap). -/
113	def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
114	  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1

116	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
117	-- Timelines
118	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
119	/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
120	    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
121	    some instant at all. -/
122	structure Timeline where

124	  live : Bool
125	  present : Bool

/-

  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Grounding
  Which assignments of tracks to binders exist over a trace, how a broken track is followed, and
  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.

  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.

  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.

  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Grounding
open Semantics

/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
structure Grounding where
  assign : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
  let c := canon cm
  { s with
    subject := s.subject.map c
    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Setup where
  rules : List Rule
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  gap : Q
  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []

def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
  let arr := τ.toArray
  let cm := canonMap arr gap
  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }

/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
  match Admission.defects τ gap with
  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
  | ds => .error ds

def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
  | _, _ => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enumeration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t

def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
  match S.span a, S.span b with
  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
  | _, _ => false

/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
    match bs with
    | [] => [[]]
    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }

/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
    bound when candidates overlap). -/
def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Timelines
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
    some instant at all. -/
structure Timeline where
  verdicts : Array (Timestamp × Verdict)
  live : Bool
  present : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Evaluate a rule for a grounding once. A binder absent inside its identity's span is an
    identity gap (unknown); absent outside it, the rule is not engaged. -/
def evaluate (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Timeline :=
  let c := S.ctx g.binding
  let engaged := r.engagedAll c
  let obl := Rule.evalRuleFormula c r.obligation
  let spans := g.assign.map fun (_, t) => (t, S.span t)
  let rows := (Array.range S.n).map fun i =>
    let s := S.scenes[i]!
    let missing := spans.filter fun (t, _) => !s.tracks.contains t
    let v : Verdict :=
      if missing.isEmpty then verdictAt engaged[i]! obl[i]!
      else
        let inGap := missing.filter fun (_, sp) => match sp with
          | some (a, b) => a < i && i < b
          | none => false
        if inGap.isEmpty then .notApplicable
        else .unknown (inGap.map fun (t, _) => .identityGap t)
    (s.t, v, missing.isEmpty && engaged[i]!.v == .t, missing.isEmpty)
  ⟨rows.map fun (t, v, _, _) => (t, v), rows.any fun (_, _, l, _) => l, rows.any fun (_, _, _, p) => p⟩

def timeline (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Array (Timestamp × Verdict) := (evaluate S r g).verdicts

/-- The verdict of a grounding at one instant. -/
def verdictAt (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) (i : Nat) : Verdict :=
  ((timeline S r g)[i]?).map (·.2) |>.getD (.unknown [.outOfRange])

/-- The episode verdict: a violation anywhere is a violation; else any unknown is unknown (with
    every reason); else engaged anywhere is compliant; else not applicable. -/
def episode (tl : List Verdict) : Verdict :=
  if tl.any (· == .violated) then .violated
  else
    let unknowns := tl.flatMap Verdict.reasons
    if tl.any (fun v => match v with | .unknown _ => true | _ => false) then .unknown unknowns.eraseDups
    else if tl.any (· == .compliant) then .compliant
    else .notApplicable

/-- Every grounding evaluated once: its episode verdict and timeline. -/
def check (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List (Grounding × Timeline × Verdict) :=
  (groundings S r).map fun g =>
    let tl := evaluate S r g
    (g, tl, episode (tl.verdicts.toList.map (·.2)))

/-- Engaged (applicability true) at some instant for some grounding: the rule says something on
    this trace. -/
def live (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Bool := (check S r).any fun (_, tl, _) => tl.live

end Grounding
end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
  What a trace must satisfy, as written, before any rule is evaluated on it: the declared facts
  (assumptions and intentions) name what their scene holds, each once, by well-formed ids; no
  structure is labelled with an abstract kind or lists one among the kinds its source cannot tell
  (an abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it, read only by a formula); and the
  accepted re-identification links are one-to-one.

  The checks are exact and read no geometry, so a recorded trace, a JSON case and a Lean witness
  are held to them alike. `Grounding.Setup.admit` calls them; every evaluation builds its setup
  there.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Identity
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Admission

private def duplicates {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups

/-- The defects of one scene's declared facts. -/
def sceneDefects (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let at_ := s!"scene t={s.t}"
  (s.intents.flatMap fun d =>
    let who := s!"{at_}: intent record ({d.vehicle}, {d.target})"
    (if s.tracks.contains d.vehicle then [] else [s!"{who}: vehicle {d.vehicle} is not a road user of the scene"]) ++
    (if (s.structure? d.target).isSome then [] else [s!"{who}: target {d.target} is not a structure of the scene"]) ++
    ((duplicates (d.values.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` listed more than once") ++
    ((d.values.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!IntId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` is not a well-formed intention id")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.intents.map fun d => (d.vehicle, d.target))).map fun (v, r) => s!"{at_}: more than one intent record for ({v}, {r})") ++
  (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
    (if st.kind.isAbstract then [s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} is labelled `{st.kind}`, an abstract kind; label it with a kind that refines `{st.kind}`"] else []) ++
    ((st.unobservedKinds.filter (·.isAbstract)).eraseDups.map fun k =>
      s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} lists `{k}` among unobserved_kinds, an abstract kind; list the kinds refining it that the source cannot tell")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.assumptions.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{at_}: assumption `{id}` listed more than once") ++
  ((s.assumptions.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!AsmId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{at_}: `{id}` is not a well-formed assumption id")

/-- Accepted links that give a track two successors or two predecessors. -/
def linkDefects (τ : Array Scene) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  let links := Grounding.acceptedLinks τ gap
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.1))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} is continued by more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.1 == t)}") ++
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.2))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} continues more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.2 == t)}")

/-- Every defect of the trace as written; empty for a trace every evaluation may read. -/
def defects (τ : Trace) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap sceneDefects ++ linkDefects τ.toArray gap

end Admission
end TrafficSpec
